_description: VG-TASK-BUDGET cases (18.175): each case is a domain binding and the records of one subject; verification/gates/task_budget.sh builds the bundle, the real Python, TypeScript and Java CLIs assess it against the baseline catalog and the Conduct overlay, and CND-07's outcome and failing records must be the expected ones in every engine. A record's kind is ToolCall, ModelCall or Refusal; class is its source class (default independent_system, a provider usage export); agentcetask is the CloudEvents task attribute and refs_task its refs.task; a ModelCall's usage is written as given; a Refusal names the record in request; subject "other" records it under a second subject, whose CND-07 reading is expected_other; time, when given, replaces the record's place-in-list time. The outcome "insufficient_evidence/class" is a subject the budgets were judged for and met, read insufficient_evidence only because the ToolCall is below CND-07's independent_system minimum (source_class_satisfied false); a bare "insufficient_evidence" is the evidence shape: the records cannot tell a budget.
